correctness.rationale: For the specific graphical group cocycle B(x,y)_{ij}=x_i y_j over F_(2^e), squares give Q(x)_{ij}=x_i x_j; order<=2 iff the support is independent, hence q^m I_Gamma(q-1). On an independent support S, commutator map C_x(y)_{ij}=x_i y_j+x_j y_i has image rank |N(S)| since different outside-neighbor variables have disjoint occupied edge-coordinate sets; therefore class sizes q^|N(S)| and K_j=q^(m-j) sum_{S indep,|N(S)|=j}(q-1)^|S|. For H containing central W, H/W is an F2-space U with Q identically zero. If two coordinate forms are nonzero on U then their proper kernels cannot cover U, so an edge cannot lie in union of supports; conversely all subspaces on independent supports work. Coordinate inclusion-exclusion gives A_r=sum_t a_t sum_{j<=t} (-1)^(t-j) binom(t,j) [ej r]_2. An inclusion-maximal elementary abelian subgroup must contain W; it is full coordinate subspace on a maximal independent set, giving maximum order q^(m+alpha) and well-covered criterion. Independent P3 F2 case: 32 group elements, 20 square-to-identity, conjugacy-class-size exponents j=0:4,j=1:6,j=2:1, maximal orders 8 and16. Read finite verifier enumerating 84 graph-field configurations; finite computations are only corroboration.
